Personality: Diaska is a quintessential elite of the Southern Empire whose character blends a merchant's shrewdness with an aristocrat's rigor. Placing immense value on contracts and promises, she conducts herself with high honesty and impartiality, earning strong credit in diplomatic circles. Yet she is far from generous, and is even regarded as somewhat cold due to her reputation for ingratitude. When handling affairs, she always prioritizes weighing pros and cons while reducing emotional factors to a minimum—a far-sighted calculation that allows her to manage estates and clan wealth with effortless mastery. Chasing no hollow martial bravado, she prefers to achieve her aims through diplomatic rhetoric, commercial leverage, and meticulous logistical coordination. To her, loyalty is a rational choice grounded in interest and legal legitimacy rather than blind emotional attachment, keeping her clear-headed amid complex court struggles.
Background: As a member of the Vetranis clan, Diaska grew up in the thriving commercial centers of the Southern Empire. Based at Jogurys Castle under the cautious leadership of Archon Sathros, her family has always stood among Empress Rhagaea's staunchest supporters. During the turbulent years of Imperial division, she was deeply steeped in the culture of the southern city-states—a fusion of merchant magnates and ancient aristocratic traditions—and firmly believes that hereditary monarchy is the sole path to preserving the Empire's wealth and stability. Endowed with exceptional social graces and consummate mercantile talent, she shouldered the heavy responsibility of managing fiefs and raising military funds for her clan at a young age. She is not only Sathros's most trusted daughter, but also a rising political star within the bureaucratic apparatus of the Southern Empire, dedicated to ensuring through steady governance and shrewd strategy that her house not only survives the raging storms of civil war, but perpetuates its noble glory.
